name: golf-cart-tracker
description: A React and Node dashboard for tracking golf cart location, fleet health, trips, charging, geofences, and maintenance operations.

scripts.start: npm run build && node src/server/index.js --provider demo --port 8765
scripts.start:trackunit: npm run build && node src/server/index.js --provider trackunit --port 8765 --no-fake-carts
